answer: An adversary thus has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 19 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The terrace counter is kept in knoll and delta exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 19 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 550 identities would post 1665 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
